title: Missing upper bound check allows out-of-bounds channel
description: Line 181 asserts `ch >= 1` but never verifies `ch < num_channels`. The implementation returns `1 + (h % n)` which can be 8 for EU868 (8 channels indexed 0-7). Verified: epoch=2 with the test EUI64 produces channel=8, which is out of bounds. The test passes despite this implementation bug.
close_reason: Fixed: Changed select_channel formula from '1 + (h % n)' to '1 + (h % (n-1))' in Python, Rust, and spec. Added upper bound assertion to test. This ensures channels are always in valid range [1, n-1] for 0-indexed arrays.
